author: China Insights
description:
Once one of China’s most powerful real estate developers, Evergrande grew into a vast empire spanning property, finance, and investments — before becoming the center of one of the largest debt crises in modern history.

In this episode, we trace the rise of its founder, the expansion of the company’s business model, and the broader system that allowed such rapid growth. By examining financial structures, policy shifts, and reported connections between business and local governance, we explore how risks accumulated over time — and why the collapse had such far-reaching consequences.

More importantly, we look at who ultimately bears the cost when a system like this begins to unravel.

title: From Richest Man to Collapse: The Rise and Fall of China’s Evergrande Empire I China Insights
